title: DecoyTrace: Toxic Decoys for Active Defense in Decentralized Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36330v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) eliminates the central aggregation server, reducing the single point of observation that traditional defenses against attacks rely on. As a result, peer-to-peer networks become exposed to malicious updates containing backdoors or semantic poisoning, since such updates can remain close to benign ones in the parameter space while behaving very differently. This may evade defenses based on passive parameter inspection. However, existing deception-based defenses have mainly been designed for centralized FL and do not jointly address local observation, poisoning propagation, source attribution, and containment in strictly serverless DFL. To address these limitations, this paper presents DecoyTrace, a proactive cyber deception-based defense for strictly serverless DFL environments. translated_title: DecoyTrace：面向去中心化联邦学习主动防御的毒性诱饵
translated_abstract: 去中心化联邦学习（DFL）消除了中央聚合服务器，削弱了传统攻击防御所依赖的单一观测点。因此，点对点网络容易受到包含后门或语义毒化的恶意更新的影响，因为此类更新在参数空间中可以与良性更新保持接近，而实际行为却大相径庭，从而可能逃过基于被动参数检查的防御。然而，现有的基于欺骗的防御机制主要针对集中式联邦学习设计，未能在严格无服务器的DFL环境中同时解决本地观测、毒化传播、来源归因和攻击遏制等问题。为解决这些局限，本文提出了DecoyTrace，一种面向严格无服务器DFL环境的、基于主动网络欺骗的防御方法。DecoyTrace部署一个移动的诱饵节点，利用混沌映射生成诱饵挑战，并传播双模型（干净模型……
tldr: 本文提出DecoyTrace，一种面向严格无服务器去中心化联邦学习的主动网络欺骗防御方法，通过移动诱饵节点生成基于混沌映射的诱饵挑战并传播双模型，实现对恶意毒化更新的检测、来源归因与遏制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DecoyTrace, a proactive cyber deception defense for strictly serverless decentralized federated learning that deploys a mobile decoy node generating chaotic-map-based decoy challenges and disseminating dual models to detect, attribute, and contain malicious poisoned updates.
